title: Best NLP Experts (2026): Text Analysis and Language AI
description: How to hire an NLP expert for text classification, sentiment analysis, extraction or search: data, evaluation, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Natural language processing (NLP) experts build systems that work with text: classifying emails, analyzing reviews, extracting names and dates from documents, summarizing reports or improving search. Many projects now combine classic NLP with large language models. Good work starts with real text samples and clear rules for what counts as correct. Projects go wrong when language and domain differences are ignored, outputs are not evaluated, or sensitive text is shared without care. This guide helps you get text AI that is accurate and useful.

faq.q: Should we use a large language model or a custom model?
faq.a: Large language models are flexible and quick to start. Smaller custom models can be cheaper and more consistent for narrow tasks. A good expert will compare both.

faq.q: Does it work in my language?
faq.a: Performance varies by language and domain. Test with your own texts in every language you need.
Use a labeled test set and measure how often outputs match the correct answers.
Remove personal details where possible and agree on where text is processed and stored.
